Hibernate: 
    select
        distinct l1_0.log_id,
        l1_0.created_at,
        l1_0.is_show,
        li1_0.log_id,
        li1_0.log_image_id,
        li1_0.public_url,
        p1_0.place_id,
        p1_0.address,
        p1_0.category,
        p1_0.place_name,
        p1_0.x,
        p1_0.y,
        l1_0.text,
        l1_0.updated_at,
        u1_0.user_id,
        u1_0.email,
        u1_0.foot_size,
        u1_0.height,
        u1_0.image,
        u1_0.introduction,
        u1_0.job,
        u1_0.nickname,
        u1_0.password,
        u1_0.refresh_token_id,
        u1_0.username,
        u1_0.weight 
    from
        log l1_0 
    join
        user u1_0 
            on u1_0.user_id=l1_0.user_id 
    join
        place p1_0 
            on p1_0.place_id=l1_0.place_id 
    left join
        log_image li1_0 
            on l1_0.log_id=li1_0.log_id 
    where
        u1_0.email=?
Hibernate: 
    select
        rt1_0.refresh_token_id,
        rt1_0.refresh_token 
    from
        refresh_token rt1_0 
    where
        rt1_0.refresh_token_id=?
Hibernate: 
    select
        u1_0.user_id,
        u1_0.email,
        u1_0.foot_size,
        u1_0.height,
        u1_0.image,
        u1_0.introduction,
        u1_0.job,
        u1_0.nickname,
        u1_0.password,
        rt1_0.refresh_token_id,
        rt1_0.refresh_token,
        u1_0.username,
        u1_0.weight 
    from
        user u1_0 
    left join
        refresh_token rt1_0 
            on rt1_0.refresh_token_id=u1_0.refresh_token_id 
    where
        u1_0.refresh_token_id=?
